raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-412 change added a filter that drops POSTED transactions arriving more than 26 hours after txn_ts. Raw transactions routinely arrive days late (e.g. batch 11, ingested 01-16, holds txn_ts from 01-13), so about 25% of valid transactions per batch, net of reversals, are silently excluded from silver and gold; txn_id is unique across raw, so there are no replayed duplicates to justify the filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
